name: Nicanor
title: One of the Seven Deacons
summary: Nicanor was one of the seven men chosen by the apostles to serve at the tables in the early church in Jerusalem. He was selected to ensure the fair distribution of food to widows, especially those who spoke Greek, and was known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom.

keyEvents.title: The Selection of the Seven Deacons
keyEvents.description: Nikanor was chosen along with six other men to serve at the tables in the church, so that the apostles could devote themselves to prayer and the ministry of the word.

keyEvents.title: The Apostles' Laying on of Hands
keyEvents.description: The seven chosen ones, including Nikanor, were presented before the apostles who prayed and laid their hands on them, setting them apart for service.

keyEvents.title: Growth of the Church
keyEvents.description: After the seven were appointed to serve, the word of God continued to spread, and the number of disciples in Jerusalem increased greatly.
